name: abu-app-recruiting
description: 招聘：从岗位到 offer，由招聘专家团负责

interface.shortDescription: 写 JD、筛简历、备面试、查行情
interface.longDescription: 给招聘专员准备的应用：岗位准备、简历筛选、面试和薪资行情四组场景，都由随阿布附带的招聘专家团负责——HR 招聘官带队，行业调研专家查行情，办公文档专家出物料。
capabilities: 读取你上传的 JD、简历和面试记录
生成 JD、筛选理由、面试评估表和薪资建议

app.promptAppend: The user works in recruiting. Deliver documents they can use directly (job descriptions, screening tables, interview kits) and ask for the position, the candidate files or the interview notes when they are missing.

slogan.zh-CN: 告诉我要招什么人，或者从下面选一件事开始
slogan.en-US: Tell me who you are hiring, or pick a task below

placeholder.zh-CN: 说说岗位名称、级别和团队情况
placeholder.en-US: Describe the role, level and team

prompt.zh-CN: 帮我写一份高级前端工程师的 JD，并定好面试题
prompt.en-US: Write a senior front-end engineer JD and draft the interview questions

prompt.zh-CN: 把这份 JD 改得更吸引人，保留必须项
prompt.en-US: Make this JD more attractive while keeping every requirement

prompt.zh-CN: 按这个岗位列出必须项和加分项
prompt.en-US: List the must-haves and nice-to-haves for this role

prompt.zh-CN: 根据这个岗位给出理想人选画像和三个寻访渠道
prompt.en-US: Give the ideal candidate profile for this role and three sourcing channels

prompt.zh-CN: 为这个岗位准备一套分层的面试题
prompt.en-US: Prepare a tiered interview question set for this role

prompt.zh-CN: 给这个岗位排一个四周的招聘计划
prompt.en-US: Lay out a four-week hiring plan for this role

placeholder.zh-CN: 把简历拖进来，说明岗位要求
placeholder.en-US: Drop the resumes in and state the requirements

prompt.zh-CN: 按岗位要求给这几份简历排序，说明每一份的筛选理由
prompt.en-US: Rank these resumes against the role and give the reason for each

prompt.zh-CN: 从这批简历里挑出值得面试的人，并写一句推荐理由
prompt.en-US: Pick the resumes worth interviewing, one line of reasoning each

prompt.zh-CN: 标出这份简历里需要在面试中核实的疑点
prompt.en-US: Flag what in this resume needs checking in the interview

prompt.zh-CN: 给这个岗位出一份面试评估表
prompt.en-US: Produce an interview scorecard for this role

prompt.zh-CN: 把这段面试记录整理成结构化的评估意见
prompt.en-US: Turn these interview notes into a structured evaluation

prompt.zh-CN: 比较这几位候选人的面试表现，给出录用建议
prompt.en-US: Compare these candidates' interviews and recommend whom to hire

title.en-US: Check the market, make the offer

prompt.zh-CN: 查一下这个岗位在这个城市的薪资范围
prompt.en-US: Look up the salary range for this role in this city

prompt.zh-CN: 根据候选人情况和行情给出报价建议
prompt.en-US: Suggest an offer based on the candidate and the market

prompt.zh-CN: 候选人要求加薪，帮我准备回应方案
prompt.en-US: The candidate asked for more; prepare my response
